title: 第21章 楚依依苏醒圣王出动第22章 大比将近深入交流
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
灵药峰。
在院中躺了一夜，第二天一早，楚依依终于苏醒过来。
在看到自己身处在一处陌生的地方时，楚依依心中既疑惑，同时又带着几分警惕。
“我记得我杀了那几人后，就昏迷过去了。”
“我怎么出现在这里？”
“还有我的身体，感觉都恢复如初了。”
从地上站起身来，楚依依满是疑问的想着。
“你醒了。”
就在这时，一道声音从楚依依不远处传来。
听到声音，楚依依立马转身朝着声音来源望去，脸上还满是谨慎神色。
“别那么紧张。”
“我要是对你动手，你觉得你还能活到现在？”
不远处，徐洋一边说着，一边朝着楚依依走来。
“你是？”
“是你救的我？”
思索了一下，楚依依觉得徐洋的话确实有道理，因此警惕心下降了不少。
“那你就高看我了。”
“禁药的副作用，我可没办法解除。”
“救你的，是我师尊。”
徐洋摇了摇头，随即开口回道。

“你师尊？”
“那他现在在哪？”
“我好当面感谢他救了我。”
救命之恩，楚依依自然是想要当面感谢一番。
“师尊还在休息，估计还好一会才会起床。”
“到时候，你再去感谢我师尊也不迟。”
“在此之前，我有些话要跟你说明白。”
徐洋若有所意的开口道。
“什么话？”听到徐洋的话，楚依依顿时疑惑问道。
“别急，这话说起来，还要从我发现你开始说起……”
接下来的时间，徐洋便将昨天发生的事情简单叙述了一遍。
对于一些无关紧要的部分，徐洋就直接跳过。
而与楚依依密切相关，尤其是李如风为何要救她的原因，徐洋则是仔仔细细说了一遍。
一炷香过后，楚依依也终于明白了事情的来龙去脉，脸上露出一抹别样的表情。
“该说的我都已经说了。”
“当时为了救你，我也只能那么说。”
“你应该不会介意吧？”
徐洋平静的问道。
“不会。”
“既是救命之恩，为前辈做些事情，也是应该的。”

楚依依明白徐洋的意思，所以没有多想就直接回复道。
“那就好，我还担心你不愿意呢。”
content_en:
Spiritual Medicine Peak.
After lying in the hospital all night, Chu Yiyi finally woke up early the next morning.
When Chu Yiyi saw that she was in a strange place, she was confused and a little wary at the same time.
"I remember I passed out after killing those people."
"Why am I here?"
"And my body, I feel as good as ever."
Standing up from the ground, Chu Yiyi was thinking full of questions.
"You're awake."
At this moment, a voice came from not far away from Chu Yiyi.
Upon hearing the sound, Chu Yiyi immediately turned around and looked towards the source of the sound, with a cautious look on her face.
"Don't be so nervous."
"If I did something to you, do you think you would still be alive?"
Not far away, Xu Yang walked towards Chu Yiyi while talking.
"You are?"
"Did you save me?"
After thinking for a while, Chu Yiyi felt that Xu Yang's words did make sense, so her vigilance dropped a lot.
"Then you think highly of me."
"I can't get rid of the side effects of banned drugs."
"The one who saved you is my master."
Xu Yang shook his head and then replied.
"Your master?"
"Then where is he now?"
"I can thank him in person for saving me."
Chu Yiyi naturally wanted to thank him in person for saving his life.
"Master is still resting. It will probably take a while before he gets up."
"When the time comes, it won't be too late for you to thank my master."
"Before that, I have something to explain to you."
Xu Yangruo said with intention.
"What are you talking about?" After hearing Xu Yang's words, Chu Yiyi suddenly asked in confusion.
"Don't worry, we have to start talking about this when I find you..."
In the following time, Xu Yang briefly recounted what happened yesterday.
For some insignificant parts, Xu Yang just skipped them.
Xu Yang explained in detail the reasons closely related to Chu Yiyi, especially why Li Rufeng wanted to save her.
After burning the incense, Chu Yiyi finally understood the whole story, with a different expression on her face.
"I've said everything that needs to be said."
"In order to save you at that time, I could only say that."
"You wouldn't mind, would you?"
Xu Yang asked calmly.
"No."
"Since it is a life-saving grace, it is also appropriate to do something for the seniors."
Chu Yiyi understood what Xu Yang meant, so she replied directly without thinking too much.
"That's good, I was worried that you wouldn't want to."
